sources.title: Knowledge-enhanced large language models for automatic lesson plan generation
sources.locator: Table4; appendix baseline prompts and automatic vs human comparison; dataavailability
sources.evidence_excerpt: Human evaluation separates structure, accuracy, logic and language; paper reports large gaps betweenGPT4andhuman scoring; baselines are older2024models.

research_failure.condition: Generation must follow structured instructional roles and Bloom levels across a complete lesson.
research_failure.finding: This paper proposes a dataset and evaluation framework; it does not establish that current frontier LLMs fail this selected lesson. LessonPlanLM provides human-rated older-model deficits in lesson structure/content/logic and shows automaticGPT4scoring does not match humans; it cannot establish currentGLMfailure.
research_failure.model_setting: See original paper and repository snapshot; not evidence about all current LLMs.
research_failure.scope: Original study conditions only; this exploratory subset cannot estimate the full benchmark.
